title: STR(I:J) substring — 1-based, inclusive both ends; lvalue assignment overwrites in place
sourceContent:
SUBROUTINE OVERWRITE_PREFIX(LINE, PREFIX)
C     LINE(1:3) on the LHS is an LVALUE that overwrites the first
C     3 characters of LINE in place. PREFIX is assumed to be exactly
C     3 characters long (or longer; only the first 3 are used due
C     to padding rules). Java String is immutable -- the port must
C     either use StringBuilder or rebuild LINE.
      IMPLICIT NONE
      CHARACTER*80 LINE
      CHARACTER*3  PREFIX
      LINE(1:3) = PREFIX
      END
notes: Substring-on-LHS is a Fortran idiom Java/C# cannot replicate without converting to StringBuilder. The spec must surface the lvalue substring so the rewrite picks an appropriate mutable string container.
